observations: pete.admin.snapshot remains read-only, idempotent and non-destructive
ordinary Pete invocation keeps the existing loopback bearer contract
pete.admin.snapshot additionally requires authenticated Hunter owner_admin context plus an independent owner capability
a caller holding only the shared Pete MCP bearer cannot obtain the owner snapshot
employee, unauthenticated, non-Hunter, empty-user, wrong-capability and unavailable-capability cases fail closed
the admin authorization object is exact-key and scoped only to pete.admin.snapshot so hidden mutation input is rejected
snapshot omits Model Fabric adapter credentials, owner capability values, private loopback URLs and raw reasoning
production startup resolves transport and admin capability from explicit environment or Hunter-managed token files without printing either value
unsupported/non-persisted cognitive state remains unavailable or not_evaluated rather than fabricated
